items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Builds the request that records a new component with its first state (POST /identities): ids, dataset, the builder objects (IdentityMetadata, SnapshotMetadata, Capture), geometry and, for a cut element, its parents. Reduces and stages the mesh files for AddComponentIdentity. No orientation or box is computed here: the server derives the frame. Meshes referenced from Rhino objects with a base-colour texture get vertex colours from it.
